name: workflow-studio
description: Create and independently verify substantial single-file artifacts or bounded multi-file repository changes through guarded visual workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run and visualize guarded Codex workflows
interface.longDescription: Workflow Studio runs two fixed guarded workflows: one for a substantial single-file artifact and one for a bounded multi-file change in an existing Git repository. Invoke it explicitly with $workflow-studio or let Codex select it when substantial local write work benefits from separate discovery, planning, implementation, review, repair, and final verification. Simple edits, read-only analysis, command-only work, external actions, and latency-sensitive tasks remain on their ordinary Codex paths. Every run returns an inline dashboard with phases, findings, file-level evidence, timing, and usage.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-studio for a bounded multi-file repository feature
Use $workflow-studio for a substantial single-file brief
Show my latest Workflow Studio run
Explain when Workflow Studio is the right choice
